name: RDB-PFN
note: RDB-PFN was developed for in-context learning with a fixed, relatively small context, without a dedicated mechanism for using the full training set, such as query-specific local sampling. For this leaderboard evaluation, we extend the released model to use more training examples through a simple ensemble of up to 8 disjoint 4,096-example contexts, averaging their predictions without retraining.
author: yanxwb
